jobs.title: Technical Data Analyst
jobs.description: Who We Are Addepar is a global data and AI platform empowering investment professionals to turn complex financial information into actionable intelligence. Addepar unifies portfolio, market and client data in a total portfolio view and delivers AI-powered insights within investment and client workflows. More than 1,500 firms in 60 countries use Addepar to manage and advise on nearly $10 trillion in assets. Its open platform integrates with 650 software, data and consulting partners to power end-to-end investment operations across firms of all sizes and levels of complexity. Addepar supports clients worldwide with offices in New York City, Salt Lake City, São Paulo, London, Edinburgh, Geneva, Warsaw, Dubai, Pune and Singapore. The Role A Technical Data Analyst is responsible for performing data migration, data conversion and data validation projects for Addepar clients using existing tools and established processes. The ideal candidate will have a good understanding of financial portfolio data, a foundational level of python programming skills, exceptional communication skills and the ability to deliver results in alignment with project deadlines while meeting high quality standards. Applicants must have, and maintain, the right to work in the United Kingdom from the first day of employment. Please note that visa sponsorship is not available for this role. What You’ll Do Convert, migrate and validate data from external or internal sources using existing tooling with defined processes and workflows Complete data projects on-time meeting project deadlines while adhering to high quality standards Coordinate across project teams communicating regular status updates for assigned data projects and while effectively setting expectations Run python ETL scripts and at times modify, fix or debug as needed Raise keys issues to project team members and senior leadership as necessary Prioritize and context-switch effectively to complete simultaneous projects; seeing each through

jobs.title: Machine Learning Engineer - Subscriptions
jobs.description: At Spotify, our Subscriptions Mission focuses on creating experiences that help listeners discover the value of Spotify, become subscribers, and stay with us for the long term. By combining technology, experimentation, and a deep understanding of our users, we help connect artists and fans while building a sustainable subscription business. Within the Subscriptions Mission, the Subs Foundational Models Product Area is part of the Subs User Understanding Studio. We build scalable machine learning solutions that personalize the subscriber journey, from conversion through to long-term retention. Working closely with teams across the mission, we develop ML solutions that improve key business metrics, including subscriber growth, monthly active users, and Premium retention. We're looking for a Machine Learning Engineer to join our Radius squad. You'll take ownership of impactful ML initiatives, develop and improve production models, and contribute to the foundational ML capabilities that power personalization and optimization across Subscriptions. Your work could include reducing friction for Free users while balancing retention and conversion, improving payment experiences to reduce Premium churn, or developing reusable models such as subscriber embeddings that support multiple products and use cases. What You'll Do Lead multi-week ML initiatives end to end, from translating business requirements into technical specifications to shipping models and measuring their impact on subscriber metrics Own components of our ML systems, making independent technical trade-offs and keeping them observable, reliable, and well documented Collaborate with a multi-functional agile team spanning user research, design, data science, product management, and engineering to build new product features that advance our mission to connect artists and fans in personalised and relevant ways Prototype new approaches and productionise solutions at scale for our hundreds of millions of active users

jobs.title: Data Scientist, Company Planning & Execution
jobs.description: How does a company with thousands of people building hundreds of products stay focused on what matters most? That's the question the Company Planning and Execution (CPE) team works on every day. We design the systems, processes, and insights that help Spotify plan, prioritise, and deliver at scale. As a Data Scientist on CPE, you'll sit at the intersection of data, strategy, and operations. You'll bring clarity to complex questions by turning operational and strategic information into clear stories, recommendations, and decision frameworks that help leaders and teams act faster and smarter. You'll also explore how AI and automation can change the way people access insights and make decisions. You'll work closely with data scientists, engineers, PMs, and business partners across the company to help refine how Spotify executes at scale. If you like making sense of ambiguity, care about how organisations work, and want your analysis to shape real decisions, this is the role. What You'll Do Formulate hypotheses related to how Spotify plans and delivers, and communicate insights effectively to a range of audiences. Apply analytical techniques — including statistical models and machine learning — to identify trends and generate insights that improve how we work. Build and maintain the data models, pipelines, and dashboards that provide visibility into how Spotify plans and executes. Develop structured narratives and recommendations — not just charts, but the "why" and "so what" — in our semi-annual Planning and Execution Insight reports and recurring briefings. Explore how AI and automation can make insights faster to produce and easier to access across the company. Who You Are Curious about how organisations work — not just the data, but the decisions and systems behind it. 5+ years of experience with a quantitative background in science, economics, engineering, or a related field. Strong interpersonal skills and comfortable working with multiple stakeholders across leve

jobs.title: Data Scientist  - Business Analytics
jobs.description: We are looking for a Data Scientist to join the Business Analytics team within Spotify’s Business Strategy and Insights organization. Our team tackles some of Spotify’s most consequential strategic questions, shaping the trajectory of our business and improving the experiences of our over 700M active users across more than 180 countries. In this role, you will use data analysis, experimentation, and statistical modeling to identify, assess, and launch a broad range of new initiatives and product features that span both product and business teams. You will also regularly assess the health of our business and identify areas of opportunity, translating these insights into clear, actionable recommendations for senior leadership. At Spotify, you'll have access to some of the richest datasets in the world and the autonomy to explore them creatively and rigorously. Above all, your work will shape how the world listens, discovers, and connects through audio. What You'll Do Develop data-driven strategies to support the growth of Spotify’s active users and subscribers Create and communicate impactful findings and recommendations that improve the Premium product Model and forecast the impact of new business initiatives Work closely with business partners to understand the changes they are driving and help them discover new opportunities for growth Analyze experiments (A/B tests; quasi-experiments) to measure the impact of new features and go-to-market initiatives Present your findings to senior leaders, influencing the course of our business Who You Are You have 5+ years of professional experience in data science or analytics, ideally at a consumer tech company or top-tier consulting firm. You are fluent in SQL and Python or R, and have a strong grasp of statistical methods and causal inference. Direct experience with product analytics or experimentation is a plus. jobs.description: 🚀 Envie de transformer la donnée en véritable levier de décision ? Chez Fleury Michon, la donnée est au cœur de nombreux enjeux business. Pour renforcer notre équipe Data au sein de la DSI , nous recherchons un(e) stagiaire Data Engineer/Reporting BI pour contribuer à la chaîne de valeur de la donnée, de sa structuration jusqu’à sa restitution. L’objectif ? Transformer des données en informations utiles et accessibles aux équipes de l’entreprise , grâce à des modèles de données fiables et des rapports Power BI adaptés aux besoins des métiers. Une mission concrète, à cheval entre data engineering et Business Intelligence , avec un impact réel sur les différents départements de l’entreprise ! 🔎 Votre mission Encadré(e) par un tuteur expérimenté, vous serez amené(e) à intervenir sur l’ensemble de la chaîne de valeur de la donnée. jobs.title: Data Engineer
jobs.description: About CuspAI CuspAI is the frontier AI company on a mission to solve the breakthrough materials needed to power human progress. While nature took billions of years to perfect molecules, we are harnessing AI to unlock trillion-dollar materials breakthroughs in months, not millennia. Our founding team is the most cited in the world, comprised of world-class researchers in AI, chemistry and engineering. We are working on some of the hardest and most important challenges including energy, clean water, the future of compute, and carbon capture, and this is just the start of what our 'search engine' for next-generation materials will unlock. We invite you to be part of a diverse, innovative team at the intersection of AI and materials science, working to create impactful partnerships that drive innovation, scalability, and industry collaboration. This work matters. Your work matters. We’re on the cusp of the on-demand materials era. Join us. In this role, you will build the foundational data systems and platforms that enable our materials scientists, machine learning engineers, and partners to collaborate on diverse datasets at scale. Your Impact As a key member of our engineering team, you will bridge the gap between complex materials science data and real-world application. You will empower researchers and machine learning models with clean, structured, and accessible data, directly accelerating our ability to discover and design breakthrough materials. What You Will Do Own the full software lifecycle of data-rich tools, services, and web applications from design through to deployment and security. Build scalable data ingestion, processing, and cleaning pipelines to handle both structured and complex unstructured data. Develop data-intensive Python APIs and intuitive web applications/UIs
